text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا

words.gloss_range: say, speak, or utter; locally a direct 2ms imperative that makes proclamation the required act
words.root_gloss_range: saying, formulated speech, accountable utterance, and contested attribution; locally authorized commanded speech rather than fabricated saying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: passive revelation report governed by the opening command
inner quoted speech answering the outer speech command

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens the ayah as a command to voice a received report, not as private information. Its bare Form I imperative makes obedient saying itself the required action, while {{ar:أُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:ūḥiya}}) keeps the source of the report outside the speaker's authorship. The same q-w-l root returns in {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}), so the ayah becomes nested speech: commanded human proclamation encloses the jinn's own testimony. Variant liaison pressure can make the command sound carried into the revelation verb, but that recitational effect remains a boundary-and-flow feature rather than a new syntax. The commanded report also points beyond astonishment, since 72:2 immediately states that the heard recitation guides to right direction.

topics.headline: imperative makes revelation public speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah begins by assigning a speaker-role, so the revealed report is meant to be proclaimed rather than privately possessed.
topics.reason: QAC parses a 2ms apocopated imperative, and attachment evidence makes the following revelation report the commanded utterance.

topics.headline: speaker agency without message ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes proclamation from authorship: the addressee must speak, while the passive revelation frame prevents the report from becoming self-originated.
topics.reason: The q-w-l field supports accountable utterance, and the contrast with fabricated attribution at 69:44 sharpens the local command as authorized speech.

topics.headline: outer command encloses inner testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as a chain of witnesses, with commanded human saying wrapped around the jinn's reported saying.
topics.reason: The same q-w-l root frames the outer command and the inner plural speech verb in one local transmission structure.

topics.headline: liaison carries sound across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a recitational pressure where the command is audibly linked into the revelation verb, while the command still remains the opening imperative.
topics.reason: The liaison reading affects delivery and boundary pressure, but QAC and local syntax still keep the command and revelation verb as distinct units.

topics.headline: command opens toward guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the commanded report does not end with astonishment; it opens into the guidance claim stated in 72:2.
topics.reason: The next ayah continues the jinn's quoted response and specifies the function of the heard recitation in 72:2.

words.gloss_range: it was revealed, communicated, or caused to reach; locally a Form IV passive perfect introducing the received report
words.root_gloss_range: swift hidden signaling, revelation, and caused communication; locally disclosed hidden communication routed to a recipient

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recipient endpoint of the revealed report
content-clause opener

words.prose: {{ar:أُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:ūḥiya}}) presents the report as already received disclosure. The passive perfect foregrounds the arrival of the message and withholds an overt sender in the local clause, while Form IV makes the communication feel caused to reach its endpoint. That endpoint appears immediately in {{ar:إِلَىَّ}} ({{tr:ilayya}}), before {{ar:أَنَّهُ}} ({{tr:annahu}}) opens the content. The w-ḥ-y field of swift hidden signaling suits the ayah's movement: a hidden-origin report about hidden listeners becomes speakable, then immediately enters commanded saying, quoted saying, and heard recitation. Variant forms show that voice and hamza are real pressure points, but the local canonical parse remains passive received revelation.

topics.headline: passive perfect foregrounds message arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the report as accomplished disclosure: the message arrives before its content unfolds, while the sender is not named in the surface clause.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV passive perfect, and attachment evidence records an implicit agent rather than an expressed subject.

topics.headline: hidden signaling becomes disclosed report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the aptness of revelation as hidden communication, especially because the disclosed content concerns hidden listeners.
topics.reason: The w-ḥ-y field supports swift concealed communication, and the nonhuman-recipient comparison in 16:68 makes hidden communication a valid cross-passage pressure.

topics.headline: caused communication reaches an endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the syntax establish the route of revelation before the hidden event itself is narrated.
topics.reason: The Form IV passive is followed by the endpoint phrase and then the content clause, producing a route-before-content structure.

topics.headline: variant forms expose but do not replace the passive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice voice and hamza as recitational pressure points while keeping the local report governed by the passive canonical form.
topics.reason: Variant readings illuminate the surface boundary and agency contrast, but they do not override QAC's local passive perfect parse.

topics.headline: revelation turns into speech and recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees revelation immediately enter the ayah's speech-and-recitation chain rather than staying as an abstract event.
topics.reason: The local sequence connects revelation with commanded saying, quoted saying, and the heard recited object.

words.gloss_range: to me, toward me, unto me; locally the first-person endpoint of the revelation route

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: passive revelation verb governing the endpoint phrase
content opener delayed until after endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىَّ}} ({{tr:ilayya}}) fixes revelation as routed to a first-person recipient before the content clause opens. The preposition and suffix are fused in one word, so direction and personal endpoint arrive together. This matters because the later plural speakers are the jinn, while this suffix marks the recipient of the report; the ayah keeps the responsible recipient distinct from the quoted witnesses. Its placement between {{ar:أُوحِىَ}} ({{tr:ūḥiya}}) and {{ar:أَنَّهُ}} ({{tr:annahu}}) delays the hidden event until the route of disclosure has been made explicit.

topics.headline: endpoint phrase routes revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices revelation moving toward a specified recipient, not floating as vague inspiration.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the prepositional phrase as the recipient complement of the passive revelation verb.

topics.headline: recipient differs from later speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the first-person recipient of revelation separate from the later first-person plural jinn witnesses.
topics.reason: Pronoun routing marks the suffix here as first-person singular recipient, while later plural forms belong to the quoted speakers.

topics.headline: compressed endpoint delays content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the syntax pause on transmission-location before the concealed listening event is disclosed.
topics.reason: The endpoint phrase intervenes between the revelation verb and its content complement.

words.gloss_range: that it, that the matter; locally a content-clause opener with an anticipatory affair pronoun

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa nafarun mina al-jinn}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the event packaged as revealed content
verb that supplies the forward event for the affair-pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُ}} ({{tr:annahu}}) turns the following listening event into the content of revelation. Its pronoun-like surface does not send the reader backward to a named noun; it points forward as an affair-pronoun until {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa}}) supplies the event. The particle and suffix compress subordination and anticipatory reference into one hinge. That hinge lets the ayah hold the matter in suspense: revelation has arrived, the recipient has been fixed, and now the concealed event is unveiled as the thing reported.

topics.headline: subordinator packages the event as revelation content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the jinn-listening scene as what was revealed, not as an independent narrative suddenly inserted after revelation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the clause opened here the content complement of the revelation verb.

topics.headline: forward pronoun suspends reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small suspense device: the pronoun-like form waits for the event itself to define the announced matter.
topics.reason: Referent evidence supports an affair-pronoun analysis with cataphoric force toward the following assertion.

topics.headline: particle and suffix compress the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees subordination and anticipatory reference arrive as one compact surface form.
topics.reason: The form fuses the content particle with the suffix that functions as the affair-pronoun.

words.gloss_range: listened attentively, sought to hear, gave ear; locally completed Form X attentive audition
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, learning by report, heeding, and making audible; locally deliberate access to hearing before first-person recognition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: delayed singular collective subject
later first-person plural hearing claim

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa}}) introduces the jinn through completed attentive listening before their identity is named. The 3ms verb matches the singular collective surface of {{ar:نَفَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nafarun}}), so the group first appears as one listening unit, not as scattered individuals. Form X gives the act a deliberate seeking-hearing force and avoids making the scene accidental sound exposure. That effort is answered inside the quote by {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}): the narrated listening becomes first-person recognized hearing. Against the failed accountable hearing recalled in 67:10, this is responsive audition, and it anticipates the hearing-and-guidance statement in 72:13.

topics.headline: verb first, listeners later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of attentive listening is disclosed before the listeners are identified.
topics.reason: QAC parses a 3ms perfect, and attachment evidence places the subject after the verb.

topics.headline: Form X makes listening deliberate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the jinn's hearing as disciplined seeking and attentive access, not passive acoustic contact or stealthy straining.
topics.reason: The Form X morphology and s-m-ʿ lexical range support intentional audition, while the local form is not the stealth-straining derivative.

topics.headline: narrated listening becomes quoted hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the same hearing root cross from narrative report into the jinn's own witness claim.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the narrative verb and later in the first-person quoted verb, linking access to recognized testimony.

topics.headline: responsive audition contrasts failed hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can set this responsive listening against failed accountable hearing in 67:10 and follow the surah's later hearing thread to 72:13.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete hearing contrasts and same-surah references, with 67:10 and 72:13 as bounded comparisons.

words.gloss_range: a band, troop, or small group; locally an indefinite nominative singular collective subject
words.root_gloss_range: going forth, mobilization, startled movement, and group emergence; locally a bounded mobile cohort from the jinn

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: verb whose delayed subject is the band
partitive qualifier restricting the band to a subgroup
definite jinn class from which the band is drawn

words.prose: {{ar:نَفَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nafarun}}) names the listeners as an indefinite band, not the entire jinn class. Its nominative case makes the group the subject of {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa}}), while its delayed placement lets listening precede identity. The singular collective form makes several persons act first as one cohort, and its n-f-r field adds mobile going-forth energy: the group feels like a bounded exploratory party emerging from {{ar:ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:al-jinn}}). Cross-references such as 74:50 and 46:29 sharpen that motion into responsive approach rather than flight or generic grouping.

topics.headline: indefinite nominative limits the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the testimony belongs to a newly introduced subgroup, not to all jinn without distinction.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an indefinite nominative singular collective, and attachment evidence makes it the delayed subject of the listening verb.

topics.headline: root image makes the band mobile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines not a static label but a moved-out cohort whose emergence fits the listening scene.
topics.reason: The n-f-r lexical field supports movement and mobilization, and the local noun selects a small group rather than an abstract motion verb.

topics.headline: one band later becomes plural speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group first as one listening unit before it opens into plural speech.
topics.reason: The singular collective noun agrees with the prior singular verb, while the later speech verb resolves the cohort into plural speakers.

topics.headline: rare band enters jinn-hearing field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the band in a marked pattern: movement that could flee in 74:50 is redirected here toward hearing, and the jinn-listening configuration is also concrete in 46:29.
topics.reason: The supplied distribution and inter-ayah rows point to 74:50 and 46:29 as bounded comparisons for n-f-r movement and jinn hearing.

words.gloss_range: from, out of, from among; locally a partitive/source bridge from the band to the jinn class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite band being classified
definite class governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the small word that prevents the band from becoming the whole class. It joins the indefinite {{ar:نَفَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nafarun}}) to the definite {{ar:ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:al-jinn}}), so the phrase means a group from among or out of that hidden class. Its particle force is both classificatory and directional: an unknown group is narrowed into a jinn subgroup, and the nasal sound of the phrase helps bind that relation audibly.

topics.headline: partitive particle limits the testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that only a subgroup from the jinn is in view, not the entire hidden class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun the governed complement of the preposition and qualifier of the band.

topics.headline: from out of and from among both help
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase move from an unknown band to a classified hidden source without totalizing the class.
topics.reason: The local phrase licenses both source and subset force because the band is identified by relation to the definite class.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds particle to class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the partitive relation as a compact sound-link between the particle and the jinn noun.
topics.reason: The surface sequence repeats nasal sounds across the preposition and following noun without changing the grammatical partitive relation.

words.gloss_range: the jinn, the concealed beings; locally a definite genitive collective class governed by the partitive phrase
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, shielded or enclosed things, hidden beings, and related concealed states; locally the known hidden class from which the listener-band is drawn

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the jinn noun
later plural speech that brings the hidden class into voice
indefinite band contrasted with the definite jinn class

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:al-jinn}}) names the known concealed class only as the governed source of the band. Its genitive case keeps the class in the background under {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}), while {{ar:نَفَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nafarun}}) remains the actual subject that listened. The j-n-n field makes hiddenness semantic rather than decorative: covered or concealed beings become audible witnesses without ceasing to be marked as hidden. Structurally, the noun moves from backgrounded class relation toward direct voice when the group later says {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}). Same-surah references keep developing jinn agency, including the shift from opening hearers to a refuge-source relation in 72:6.

topics.headline: known class, bounded subgroup
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a known hidden class named only after the testimony has already been limited to one subgroup.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the noun as definite genitive under the preposition, not as the subject itself.

topics.headline: concealed beings become witnesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the surprise of hidden beings becoming linguistically present as hearers and speakers.
topics.reason: The j-n-n lexical field supports concealment and hidden beings, and the local noun selects the concealed-being derivative field rather than garden or madness senses.

topics.headline: backgrounded jinn become quoted speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a role shift: the jinn are first a genitive background class, then emerge as the voice of testimony.
topics.reason: The local syntax backgrounds the class under the preposition, and the subsequent plural speech verb brings the group into direct discourse; 6:130 provides an address contrast.

topics.headline: opening role develops across the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the opening jinn-listener role into later same-surah distinctions such as the refuge relation in 72:6.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah rows identify continued jinn references, especially the role shift in 72:6.

words.gloss_range: then, so, and then; locally a prefixed sequence-consequence particle linking listening to speech

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: listening event before the connector
speech verb carrying the prefixed particle

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is small but decisive: it turns listening into immediate speech. The particle carries both sequence and consequence, so the ayah does not simply list two events; it makes {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) follow as the prompt outcome of {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa}}). Because the bundle splits the prefix from the verb, its force can be seen clearly before it fuses back into the recited form: perception is complete, then testimony begins.

topics.headline: speech follows listening tightly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices testimony as the immediate outcome of listening, not a loose later report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the clause as sequenced after the listening event, and the particle supplies tight succession and consequence.

topics.headline: connector converts audition into testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle as a hinge: it links the acts while preserving listening and saying as two ordered moments.
topics.reason: The connector stands between the listening and speech clauses, making the second a result without collapsing it into the first.

topics.headline: prefix makes consequence visible and audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consequence is not only semantic; it is attached to the speech verb's surface form.
topics.reason: QAC separates the prefixed particle for analysis while the recited surface fuses it to the following speech verb.

words.gloss_range: they said, they spoke, they stated; locally a 3mp perfect opening direct jinn testimony after the sequence particle
words.root_gloss_range: saying, formulated report, accountable claim, and contested attribution; locally a witnessed report, not reciprocal dialogue or fabrication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: direct quotation opened by the speech verb

words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) is where the one listening band becomes plural witnesses. The perfect speech verb opens direct quotation, and the plural agreement resolves {{ar:نَفَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nafarun}}) into speakers without losing its earlier cohort shape. As q-w-l, the verb makes perception accountable as formulated testimony rather than dialogue or chatter. It also answers the opening {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}): commanded human saying encloses jinn saying, and the direct speech it opens continues into the response of 72:2. The same-surah speech thread later contrasts this testimony with mistaken saying in 72:4.

topics.headline: one band resolves into speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the singular collective listener group turn into plural speaking witnesses at the moment direct quotation begins.
topics.reason: QAC parses a 3mp perfect verb, and attachment evidence routes its subject back to the nearby listening group.

topics.headline: speech makes hearing reportable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the jinn's speech as accountable testimony to what was heard, not reciprocal conversation or invented attribution.
topics.reason: The q-w-l field supports formulated claim and accountable speech; 69:40 provides a delivered-speech comparison while the local form remains simple Form I.

topics.headline: the prefix binds saying to listening

topics.reason: The visible fāʾ prefix attaches sequence and consequence to the speech verb.

topics.headline: quote boundary opens jinn discourse

topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following clause the quoted complement, and supplied same-surah rows track the q-w-l speech thread through later jinn statements such as 72:4.

topics.headline: inner saying answers outer command

topics.reason: The opening command and this quoted speech verb share the q-w-l root and frame the ayah's transmission chain.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate claim asserted by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) turns the jinn's quote into emphatic collective testimony. The particle scopes over the whole predicate {{ar:سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā qurʾānan ʿajaban}}), so the hearing claim arrives as confirmed witness speech. Its fused first-person plural pronoun changes the report's perspective: the hidden group that was narrated from outside now speaks as 'we.' The repeated n/nā sound carries that collective identity into the following hearing verb.

topics.headline: emphasis covers the whole hearing claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the jinn's statement as confirmed testimony over the entire claim of hearing a wondrous recitation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following hearing clause the predicate under the emphatic particle.

topics.headline: speaker identity and emphasis fuse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices emphasis and collective self-reference arriving in one word before the hearing verb.
topics.reason: The first-person plural pronoun is fused to the emphatic particle and resolves to the speakers introduced by the plural speech verb.

topics.headline: reported group speaks as we
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse pivot from third-person report about a band into the band's own first-person testimony.
topics.reason: The direct-speech boundary has opened, and this pronoun marks the narrated group as self-identifying speakers.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds identity to hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears collective identity carried into the hearing claim by repeated n/nā sounds.
topics.reason: The local surface repeats nasal sounds across the emphatic pronoun and the following first-person plural verb.

words.gloss_range: we heard, we perceived, we recognized by hearing; locally a Form I perfect with 1cp subject and explicit object

words.prose: {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}) gives the jinn's own completed hearing claim. The verb carries a first-person plural subject that continues {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}), and it governs {{ar:قُرْءَانًا}} ({{tr:qurʾānan}}) as an explicit object, so the hearing is not vague perception. After {{ar:ٱسْتَمَعَ}} ({{tr:istamaʿa}}), this simple Form I states the achieved result: deliberate audition has become recognition of recited discourse. Under the emphatic predicate, the clause packages reception, object-identification, and evaluation as one witness sentence. The same root bridges narrative and quote here, recalls the jinn-hearing scene in 46:29, and anticipates the later hearing of guidance in 72:13.

topics.headline: first-person hearing names its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a completed collective hearing claim with an explicit object, not a vague report of sound.
topics.reason: QAC parses a Form I perfect with first-person plural subject, and attachment evidence identifies the following noun as its direct object.

topics.headline: hearing includes uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hearing claim as perceptive uptake and classification of the recitation as Qurʾān.
topics.reason: The s-m-ʿ lexical field can include uptake, and the local object plus final qualifier turn hearing into identified and evaluated reception.

topics.headline: simple hearing states the achieved result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the earlier deliberate listening from the achieved hearing result inside the quote.
topics.reason: The ayah first uses Form X for attentive listening and then Form I for the completed first-person hearing claim.

topics.headline: root bridge joins narration, quote, and guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the hearing root from reported listening into quoted recognition, with 46:29 as a jinn-hearing parallel and 72:13 as the later guidance hearing.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete inter-ayah references at 46:29 and 72:13 and a local same-root bridge.

words.prose: {{ar:قُرْءَانًا}} ({{tr:qurʾānan}}) fixes what the jinn heard: not undifferentiated sound, but a recognized recited discourse. Its accusative case makes it the object of {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}), and its indefiniteness before {{ar:عَجَبًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿajaban}}) gives the object qualitative force, a recitation of wondrous kind. The q-r-ʾ field keeps reciting and ordered gathering together, so the heard object is a voiced, organized whole. The internal hamza and eased reading expose sound texture without changing the object function. The recognition is striking because hidden outsiders name the Qurʾān at first hearing; 17:9 names its guiding force, 46:29 gives a jinn-hearing parallel, and 72:2 immediately specifies this wondrous recitation as guidance.

topics.headline: accusative object fixes the hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the jinn's hearing directed toward a named recited discourse rather than vague sound.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the accusative direct object of the first-person hearing verb.

topics.headline: indefiniteness opens wondrous quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object presented qualitatively before the final word names its wonder.
topics.reason: The noun and following qualifier are both indefinite accusatives, supporting a qualitative object reading.

topics.headline: recitation is ordered discourse

topics.reason: The q-r-ʾ field supports reciting and gathering into ordered reading, and the local noun carries both process and identity.

topics.headline: hamza texture does not alter grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the root-bearing hamza and the eased variant as sound texture while keeping the same direct object and meaning.
topics.reason: The reading variant changes articulation of the hamza but does not change the local object relation under the hearing verb.

topics.headline: heard Qurʾān opens into guidance

words.root_gloss_range: marvel, admiration, astonishment, strangeness, anomaly, and caused or expressed wonder; locally embodied wonder attached to the Qurʾān as heard discourse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the heard recitation qualified by wonder

words.prose: {{ar:عَجَبًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿajaban}}) is the ayah's evaluative landing. Its accusative indefiniteness agrees with {{ar:قُرْءَانًا}} ({{tr:qurʾānan}}), so it qualifies the heard recitation rather than adding a second object; as a verbal noun used adjectivally, it makes the recitation feel like wonder embodied, not merely described as wondrous. The ʿ-j-b field combines admiration with cognitive disruption, and comparison with 18:9 and 50:2 keeps this direct wonder-quality for Qurʾān distinct. Its rare gerund form and final position cast the whole chain of command, revelation, listening, and testimony under that evaluation. The tanwīn cadence links the band, the Qurʾān, and wonder, while 72:2 immediately explains why this wonder matters: it guides.

topics.headline: accusative wonder qualifies the recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as a quality attached to the heard Qurʾān, not as a separate object or loose exclamation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows adjective or quality-specifying analysis, and the case/indefiniteness match binds the word to the preceding object.

topics.headline: verbal noun intensifies wonder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels wonder as both admiration and disruption, intensified by the verbal noun form.
topics.reason: The ʿ-j-b lexical family supports marvel, astonishment, and strangeness, and QAC identifies a gerund/verbal noun used adjectivally.

topics.headline: tanwīn leaves wonder qualitative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears wonder as an open qualitative force rather than a fixed label.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative ending supports qualitative openness attached to the recited object.

topics.headline: wonder term is marked by comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare this direct wonder-quality for Qurʾān with other marvel terms at 18:9 and 50:2, while noticing the rare gerund form's local force.
topics.reason: The supplied rows provide concrete comparisons at 18:9 and 50:2 and mark the gerund form as distributionally uncommon.

topics.headline: wonder closes the transmission chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final word color the whole chain and then open directly into the guidance explanation in 72:2.
topics.reason: The final position closes the ayah's movement, the tanwīn sound links earlier indefinite nouns, and 72:2 specifies the guidance significance of the wonder.

branches.image_en:

2. womb gathering and bearing

branches.scope_en:
1. This covers qur' and its plurals for menstruation, purity, the end of menstruation, the interval between two menstruations, entering menstruation after purity, and women's waiting-period usage.
2. Womb-related gathering, bearing, or its idiomatic negation, including fetus, blood, pregnancy, and reported casting meanings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of commanded speech, hidden imparting, doubled hearing, and quoted speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two articulated speech acts frame a concealed imparting and a doubled act of hearing, while Quran names recitation as an orally delivered form. The focus therefore behaves as a relay in which reception becomes testimony rather than remaining a private auditory event.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies both the opening command and the listeners' voiced report, forming the relay's two public edges.
Hidden imparting supplies the concealed incoming transfer that the command makes reportable.
Auditory perception supplies the repeated reception point, first narrated and then owned by the listeners.
Reading and recitation identify the heard object as transmissible voiced discourse rather than undifferentiated sound.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports that jinn heard a remarkable recitation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a relay: a command voices a hidden imparting, deliberate audition receives it, and the hearers revoice it as testimony.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A nafar from the jinn deliberately listens and answers in the first-person plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nafar supplies a socially coherent supporting band, while jinn supplies concealment. Deliberate hearing with understanding moves that band from hiddenness into coordinated receptivity and a shared voice.

activation_trace.role: A mustered or supporting band supplies the listeners' compact social agency rather than a loose numerical plurality.
Covering and concealment supply the boundary from which the listening band becomes perceptible through speech.
Understanding and compliance turn hearing into coordinated uptake and prepare the plural response.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous set of hidden beings happens to overhear.
changed_reading.after: A concealed but organized band crosses into deliberate, intelligible reception and emerges as a collective witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object heard is Quran qualified as ajab.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Quran root supplies gathering and a directed pattern, while ajab supplies unfamiliarity and captivation. Wonder can therefore arise from encountering an unexpectedly coherent course, not only from encountering something bizarre.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies internal collection, making the recitation a composed whole whose parts belong together.
A manner, pattern, or directed course supplies the functional shape taken by that gathered whole.
Wonder at the unfamiliar supplies the listeners' recognition that this pattern exceeds their prior frame.
Captivating social attraction supplies the pull that keeps unfamiliarity from remaining mere estrangement.

changed_reading.before: Ajab labels the recitation as simply strange or marvelous.
changed_reading.after: Ajab registers the arresting force of a newly encountered, gathered pattern whose coherent course captures attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate guidance, straight practical direction, and settled trust convert the focus's wonder from a mainly affective response into recognition of navigational efficacy. The gathered course does something: it finds a direction and produces a stable commitment.

activation_trace.role: The Quran's patterned, directed course supplies the focus anchor that context can specify as guidance.
Unfamiliar wonder supplies the initial affect that is reclassified by the following effects.
Gentle indication toward a road and truth supplies the recital's newly explicit directional function.
A straight road away from error specifies the destination and quality of that direction.
Heart-settling assent supplies the durable response produced by the direction.

structural_cues: 72:2 immediately predicates guidance of the heard Quran and follows it with first-person plural faith.
72:13 repeats the sequence hearing, guidance, and faith, confirming a reception-to-commitment pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wonder, guidance, right direction, and assent; I supply the arrow from unfamiliar impact to recognized navigational efficacy. A live alternative is that wonder remains aesthetic while guidance comes only from the propositions heard.

changed_reading.before: The listeners are impressed by an unfamiliar recitation.
changed_reading.after: Their wonder is recognition that the gathered recitation supplies a viable course out of error and into settled trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast among speech, mental lightness, deviation, conjecture, and falsehood makes the focus's direct hearing an epistemic correction. Concealed imparting and understood audition interrupt inherited assertions and allow the band to audit what its community had been saying.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies a source of knowledge distinct from the community's circulating assumptions.
Understanding and compliance make firsthand hearing capable of revising belief rather than merely adding sound.
False saying or attribution exposes speech as an epistemically risky vehicle against which the focus testimony is tested.
Lightness and deficiency of judgment identify the defective agency behind the prior assertion.
Deviation from truth supplies the directional error of that assertion.
Conjecture and imagining supply the band's acknowledged former epistemic basis.
The opposite of truth names the failure that firsthand reception now exposes.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 place a deviant saying beside the listeners' confession that their prior assumption excluded lying.
The shift from third-person reporting in the focus to repeated first-person confessions makes revision audible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct hearing followed by diagnoses of foolish speech, deviation, conjecture, and falsehood; I infer that the heard Quran functions as the corrective evidence. The live alternative is that these are only doctrinal conclusions, not a contrast between firsthand and inherited knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The band reports a surprising object it has heard.
changed_reading.after: The band reports the event by which direct, intelligible reception broke an inherited chain of confident but false speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes former fixed listening posts from a present regime of guarding and surveillance. Against that closure, the focus's successful doubled hearing looks less like generic eavesdropping and more like reception through a newly available, legitimate recited channel.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies protected information whose route of access becomes the issue.
Successful auditory reception supplies the focus event that contrasts with the blocked listening regime.
Guarding supplies the active closure around the older information source.
Sitting in ambush or surveillance supplies the old fixed extraction posture.
Attempted hearing supplies the repeated activity whose present outcome has changed.
Watching and guarding supply the intercept awaiting any renewed attempt.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 move from touching the heaven to finding it filled, then contrast former seats with whoever listens now.
The focus repeats the same hearing root but attaches it to Quran rather than to the former seats.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successful Quran-hearing beside failed present access to guarded listening posts; I infer a replacement from extraction to offered recitation. A live alternative is that the band simply heard an earthly recitation after the celestial closure, without the text marking its access as licensed.

changed_reading.before: The jinn happen to hear in the same general way they had listened before.
changed_reading.after: Their hearing marks a channel change: protected information is no longer taken from fixed posts but received through articulated Quran.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later self-description divides the jinn among sound and deviant members and among sharply differentiated tracks. The focus nafar can therefore be read as a particular coalition whose shared listening produces a new common voice, not as the whole species speaking uniformly.

activation_trace.role: A supporting band supplies a bounded collective able to differ from the wider population.
Mutual verbal negotiation supplies a social mechanism by which a band can arrive at and voice a shared stance.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies one internal alignment among the jinn.
An extended route supplies the social and practical tracks along which groups move.
Differentiated paths and factions supply explicit internal plurality rather than a single jinn position.
Handing oneself over supplies one response trajectory produced within that plurality.
Deflection from justice supplies the competing trajectory that the listener-band does not erase.

structural_cues: 72:11 repeats minna and describes plural, cut-apart paths; 72:14 repeats the internal division in paired clauses.
The focus says only a nafar from the jinn, preserving subset language from the outset.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded band, internally divided paths, and later opposed alignments; I infer that shared hearing creates a coalition voice across a plural field. A live alternative is that the later divisions describe jinn society generally and not the particular listeners.

changed_reading.before: The jinn as a homogeneous class hear and speak together.
changed_reading.after: A particular band forms a shared testimony within a society of divided paths, so its plural voice is an achieved alignment rather than a species-wide consensus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene of a servant rising to call while a crowd nearly piles around him activates the focus's speech sequence as socially aggregative. Heard discourse is revoiced by a band and can gather further bodies into a dense, unstable public.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public report supplies the potential for the listeners' saying to move beyond their first encounter.
The supporting band supplies the first compact social unit formed around reception.
Rising with resolve supplies the caller's public initiation of the later scene.
Calling and inclining by speech supply the attracting or provoking verbal force.
A multitude layered one over another supplies the dense social result around the caller.

structural_cues: 72:19 places a singular standing caller against a plural mass nearly compacted around him.
The focus already moves from a singular command to a band's plural quotation, providing a smaller call-and-response form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public calling and a piled crowd; I infer that the focus's heard-and-repeated speech participates in the same aggregation dynamic. The live alternative is that the later crowd is hostile pressure rather than attraction, so aggregation need not imply assent.

changed_reading.before: The listeners' saying is only a private report among themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their saying is the first visible node in a public circulation capable of gathering a dense, contested audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later denial of control and the exception of delivery distinguish ownership of outcomes from carriage of a message. Read backward, the focus's imperative and passive revelation mark a bounded office: receive, voice, and deliver, without possessing the harm, benefit, or guidance produced.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the carrier's assigned outward act.
Hidden imparting supplies received content whose source is outside the speaker's ownership.
Hearing without itself reaching a destination supplies the intermediate state that onward delivery must complete.
Possession and disposal supply precisely the control the speaker denies having over the audience.
Harm or loss supplies one outcome placed outside the speaker's power, paired in the ayah with right direction.
Causing a message to reach supplies the positive task left after control is denied.
Messenger and message supply the role-content pair that defines bounded carriage.

structural_cues: 72:20-22 repeat the command Say while progressively denying partnership, control, and refuge.
72:23 follows those denials with an exception centered on delivery and messages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated commanded speech, denied control, and delivery as exception; I apply that role boundary backward to the passive revelation in the focus. A live alternative is that the denial concerns only power toward the immediate audience and does not define every link in the focus relay.

changed_reading.before: Say introduces an authoritative speaker who reports and directs the event.
changed_reading.after: Say assigns a constrained carrier: authority lies in faithful reception and delivery, not in possession of the message or its effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant qawl-to-q-l-l mapping is activated by the later explicit comparison of fewer number and counted quantity. Together with nafar, it permits a form-distant reading in which the force of Say/they said is carried by a numerically small witness rather than by mass support.

activation_trace.role: The split root's fewness and smallness image gives the repeated qawl forms a deliberately form-distant minority echo.
A compact supporting band keeps the minority echo anchored in the focus's explicit social scale.
Explicit fewness supplies the context activation for the focus inventory's non-dominant mapped root.
Counting the numbered supplies the headcount scale against which verbal witness gains disproportionate force.

structural_cues: The focus pairs a singular commanded voice with a small nafar that answers collectively.
72:24 explicitly compares weakness of support and fewness of number, making scale a later evaluative category.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split qawl mapping into q-l-l, a nafar, and later explicit fewness/count; I infer a rhetorical resonance in which testimony outruns headcount. The live alternative is that the split mapping is only formal resolution noise and should carry no semantic pressure here.

changed_reading.before: The band's report matters because it confirms a remarkable mass response.
changed_reading.after: The report gains force precisely as a small witness's speech: numerical fewness does not limit the reach of faithful testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence turns hiddenness, selective disclosure, messenger selection, routed guarding, completed delivery, encompassing knowledge, and exhaustive count into a custody pipeline. The focus's revelation and hearing become an endpoint of controlled disclosure rather than an accidental leak from the unseen.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies the focus transfer that the closing sequence resolves into a custody process.
Concealment supplies a focus-side receiver boundary, making controlled appearance and access salient.
Being hidden from eyes supplies the protected informational domain.
Emergence and disclosure supply the controlled transition out of that hidden domain.
Approval rather than displeasure supplies the selection threshold for disclosure.
The messenger supplies the selected human link through which hidden content is carried.
Inserting one thing into another supplies deliberate routing rather than unbounded exposure.
Watching and guarding supply custody around the routed messenger.
Message delivery supplies the pipeline's required successful output.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and securing supplies end-to-end oversight.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies audit rather than merely broad awareness.
Counting the countable supplies the audit unit that closes the disclosure sequence.

structural_cues: 72:26-27 use an exception structure: the unseen is not disclosed except through an approved messenger.
The guard is spatially placed before and behind the messenger, followed by a purpose clause about completed delivery.
72:28 closes with encompassing and counting language, turning protection into accountable completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, selective appearance, a messenger, routed guards, delivery, encompassing, and count; I connect them as a custody pipeline and place the focus hearing downstream of it. A live alternative is that the closing custody guarantees only messenger delivery and does not characterize the jinn's later reception as authorized.

changed_reading.after: The focus compresses the receiving end of a guarded disclosure pipeline: hidden content is selected, routed, delivered, heard, and made auditable through testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps discourse into hydraulic and metallurgical material process. It remains anchored in Quran as gathering and directed course and in hearing as uptake, while the context supplies path, watering, abundance, and assay. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for patterned reception, not claim that the ayat lexically equate Quran with water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it aligns hidden spirits, a womb branch of Quran's gathering root, and later birth language into a gestational image. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hidden imparting reaches concealed beings through Quran as an enclosing gathering and then becomes speech.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies the initially interior, unexposed content.
A fetus hidden in the womb supplies a branch-explicit image of concealed development.

The occurrence of birth and putting down a pregnancy activates emergence as the analogy's terminal contrast, even though the ayah negates offspring.

changed_reading.before: Hidden revelation is simply made audible and then reported.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained analogy, gathered hidden content is carried through concealment until listening brings it to voiced emergence.

strongest_changes: Ajab shifts from raw marvel to recognition of a gathered course that guides and produces settled trust.
Direct hearing becomes an epistemic break with inherited conjecture and false speech.
The focus listening contrasts with closed extraction posts and is later framed by a guarded, auditable disclosure pipeline.
Say is bounded as faithful carriage and delivery rather than ownership of outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several relay stages into one ayah and repeats both speech and hearing, allowing context to activate channel, custody, social-coalition, and epistemic-correction models without dissolving the focus anchors. The split qawl mapping also preserves an unusually inspectable minority-voice activation.
remaining_uncertainties: The protected-channel reading cannot decide whether the focus audition is positively authorized or merely juxtaposed with failed celestial access.
The dense crowd in 72:19 may be attracted, hostile, or mixed, so social aggregation does not by itself establish assent.
The qawl-to-fewness delta and the hydraulic and gestational outliers are intentionally form-distant analogies and should not displace the stronger relay readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Concealed transmission becoming articulated testimony.** `أوحي` activates و ح ي B001/B004, hidden imparting and divine message; `استمع/سمعنا` activates س م ع B001 and especially B003, hearing that becomes understanding and compliance; `الجن` activates ج ن ن B001/B005, concealment and hidden beings; and `قالوا` activates ق و ل B001, uttered speech. The sequence moves from commanded speech, through hidden imparting and concealed hearers, to their own explicit report. The abductive move is that successful reception is evidenced by the hearers’ ability to restate its effect. The ayah thus reads as a conversion of hidden access into accountable testimony, not as mere acoustic contact.

2. **A withdrawing band remustered by gathered recitation.** `نفر` holds ن ف ر B001-B003: drawing away, mustering forth, and a supporting band; `قرآنا` activates ق ر ء B001’s variants, gathering and gathering speech into recitation; `عجبا` activates ع ج ب B001/B003, unfamiliar wonder and impressive attraction. The fixed sequence places the band between attentive hearing and its report of a gathered discourse. The inferred mechanism is that what arrests the group’s withdrawal can also muster it into witness. The “band” therefore reads dynamically: a potentially dispersing body is reorganized by recitation into a speaking collective.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The guarded listening of 72:9 and guarded messenger of 72:27 retrospectively distinguish this hearing from illicit extraction: the surprising issue is authorized reception, not whether concealed beings can hear.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A concealed transmission becomes public testimony.** Fixed `و ح ي` B001 is hidden imparting of knowledge, `ج ن ن` B005 identifies hidden beings, and fixed `ق و ل` B001 is uttered speech. The ayah reverses concealment in stages: covert imparting to the singular addressee, attentive listening by concealed beings, then their plural utterance; 72:4-5 tests utterance by exposing extravagant and false speech. The packet supplies the hidden channel and successive speech acts; I infer that trustworthy transmission is being verified by its movement into accountable quotation. `أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ` thus reads as the first link in an auditable relay, not merely private reception.

2. **Listening is demonstrated by changed allegiance.** The contrast between fixed `ٱسْتَمَعَ`/`سَمِعْنَا` (`س م ع` B001, attentive hearing) and `س م ع` B003, understanding that issues in acceptance and compliance, is activated by the immediate `فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِ` and `لَن نُّشْرِكَ` in 72:2. The packet supplies hearing followed by assent and refusal of partnership; I infer that the later conduct diagnoses what kind of hearing occurred. The doubled hearing therefore marks a transition from acoustic access to obedient uptake.

3. **A recitation that gathers a dispersed band.** Fixed `ق ر ء` B001 contains the variant image "collecting and gathering" as well as gathering speech into recitation; fixed `ن ف ر` B003 is a small supporting band, while B001 preserves its recoil/separation image. Their declaration is plural, and 72:2-5 gives a compact shared confession. The packet supplies a potentially scattered/recoiling band and gathered recited speech; I infer that the recitation supplies the organizing center that turns separate hearers into a speaking `نَفَر`. `قُرْءَانًا` consequently reads as socially aggregative speech, not only a textual object.

4. **Wonder is epistemic, then corrective.** Fixed `ع ج ب` B001 is wonder at what is unfamiliar or causally unknown, whereas B003 is what strikes the perceiver as pleasing or impressive. The following ayat specify the content that corrects prior assumptions: right course (72:2), non-genealogical lordship (72:3), and recognition of false attribution (72:4-5). The packet supplies the initial affect and the subsequent corrections; I infer that the wonder is generated by explanatory reordering rather than novelty alone. `عَجَبًا` reads as the felt onset of a revised causal model.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:23, 72:27, and 72:28 turn the relay inferred here into an explicit architecture: `ب ل غ` B002 names delivery, `ر س ل` B002 binds messages to carriers, prepared guards surround the approved carrier, and completion is known and counted. That sequence makes the fixed movement from hidden `و ح ي` B001 to quoted plural speech more strongly auditable than the initial window alone showed.

baseline.text: De ki: Bana, cinlerden bir topluluğun dinlediği vahyedildi. Onlar şöyle dediler: Biz gerçekten şaşırtıcı bir Kur'an dinledik.

findings.text: Gizli bildirim, gizli varlıkların işitmesinden onların açık tanıklığına ilerleyerek denetlenebilir bir aktarım zincirine dönüşür.
İşitmenin gerçek niteliği, 72:2'de bağlılığın değişmesiyle ortaya çıkar; burada yalnız ses alma değil, anlayıp benimseme etkinleşir.
Kur'an'ın toplayıcı yönü, dağılmaya açık topluluğu ortak bir tanıklıkta yeniden bir araya getirir.
Şaşkınlık, yalnız yenilik duygusu değil, sonraki ayetlerde eski varsayımları düzelten yeni bir açıklama düzeninin başlangıcıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene begins with content delivered out of sight and allows several materializations of that hidden transfer: sign, inscription, and quiet sound. The root of recitation adds collection before vocalization, while hearing supplies the receiving operation and the group's speech supplies public uptake. Wonder is therefore not an isolated reaction; it marks the point at which a concealed dispatch has survived encoding, gathering, voicing, and reception.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing becomes direction, comprehension, and secure assent
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Received sound is understood and obeyed, takes the form of a leading direction, reaches a sound course of action, and settles as trust rather than mere acoustic contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: understanding and compliance after hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); gentle direction toward a road or truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); an affair's orientation and manner (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); a guide or leading front (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); a straight route away from error (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound practical judgment (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); inward security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); assent that quiets the heart (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hearing is extended from a bodily event into an ordered transition: comprehension, compliance, orientation, and practical judgment. The guide can be both a person at the front and the leading edge of a moving body, so the heard message does not merely indicate a road; it reorganizes the hearer into a following position. Faith is the resulting settled trust, not a second, unrelated theme.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Concealed Dispatch Becomes Epistemic Commitment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A message moves through controlled stages from hidden transmission to audible form, understanding, and committed response; failure occurs when speech detaches from that chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The lexical network treats revelation less as a static text than as a custody chain whose successive operations can be contrasted with the uncontrolled manufacture and circulation of claims.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Speech detaches from evidence and becomes injurious attribution
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Unstable judgment produces excessive or deviant speech, which circulates as hearsay and finally attributes to another words or realities that were never established.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lightness and agitation (`quranic:root_000717:B001/m01`); deficient judgment (`quranic:root_000717:B002/m01`); declaring a person or view foolish (`quranic:root_000717:B004/m01`); excessive distance beyond a limit (`quranic:root_000795:B001/m01`); deviation from truth in judgment (`quranic:root_000795:B002/m01`); fabricated attribution (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); an unvoiced proposition in the mind (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); a proposition hardened into doctrine (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); falsehood opposed to truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); charging another with falsehood (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); deceptive appearance (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The operation is not simply "bad speech." Mental lightness destabilizes judgment; distance and lateral deviation remove a claim from the truth; private formulation then becomes public circulation and false attribution. The deceptive cloth that misstates its own condition gives the process a material endpoint: an utterance can present a patterned surface that does not correspond to what it covers.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Exclusive Sovereignty Closes Household Succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Possession, partnership, household formation, and biological continuation are alternative mechanisms for extending authority, and the pericope denies that the Lord's exalted rule depends on any of them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The denial of consort and child is expanded into a complete social and reproductive chain, from acquisition and marriage through gestation, birth, and derivative continuation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The consort-to-lineage chain is denied in full
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Companionship can become marriage, marriage can establish a household, the womb can conceal and gather a fetus, and birth can continue a line; the surface denial cuts this entire chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: companionship and sustained association (`quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`); making something a continuing companion (`quranic:root_000844:B004/m01`); a child growing into a companion (`quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`); marital partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B003/m01`); a stepchild and household guardian (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); a bride conveyed to a husband (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); a fetus concealed in the womb (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); a womb gathering a pregnancy (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); offspring (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); parenthood (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); parturition (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); a newborn or young dependent (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); generation of one thing from another (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lexical branches supply the stages suppressed by the terse surface negation: association, marital transfer, household incorporation, concealment in a womb, delivery, and derived continuation. Because these are successive operations rather than a list of family terms, the channel sharpens the claim: divine sovereignty neither originates in a household alliance nor persists through reproductive succession.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Refuge Brokerage Reverses into Encroachment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protection relation should place a vulnerable party within another's shelter, but the human-jinn arrangement reverses the roles and enlarges the very pressure it was meant to contain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Refuge appears as a social contract, a physical enclosure, and an occult appliance; every form is vulnerable to capture by the broker who claims to provide it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Protective devices become means of restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A charm, amulet, shield, hidden place, or divinatory procedure is installed to ward off danger, yet the same apparatus can immobilize judgment or hold its user.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an incantation or bead that restrains marriage or opinion (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); amulet and protective recitation (`quranic:root_001059:B002/m01`); a shield used for defense (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); a hiding place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); a covenant of protection (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); divination by pebbles or traced marks (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The protective field is materially complete: spoken formula, portable amulet, shield, hiding place, covenant, and divinatory reading. The crucial reversal is already present inside the evidence: the charm that should secure its bearer can instead bind a person or arrest a decision. That reversal prepares the surface outcome in which recourse to hidden protectors increases rather than relieves exposure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed sitting place (`quranic:root_001244:B001/m01`); sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); auditory capture (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); the ear as receiving aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a designated watch-place or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); set trap (`quranic:root_000932:B013/m01`); stalking behind cover (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A bright projectile performs the interception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The defended post launches a brilliant moving flame with the force of a combatant or charge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: brilliant flame or falling meteor (`quranic:root_000821:B002/m01`); warrior advancing in battle (`quranic:root_000821:B003/m01`); mixed light and darkness on the projectile (`quranic:root_000821:B001/m01`); flying sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); cutting and scattering under impact (`quranic:root_000787:B004/m01`); a forceful charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); a group rising to battle (`quranic:root_001532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interceptor combines optical, thermal, and martial roles. Its mixed brightness gives it visible form, sparks supply dispersing fragments, and charge and warrior imagery give it directed agency. The flame is therefore not scenery around the guard system but the system's moving strike.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Security Settles an Account between Shortfall and Overload
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Trust is represented as a protected settlement in which neither value nor capacity is reduced and no extra burden is imposed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The promise attached to faith is framed simultaneously as psychological security and exact accounting, joining the heart's calm to a balanced ledger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Trust replaces anticipated harm with inward security
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Received guidance produces assent and an inward state that no longer projects or displays approaching harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inward safety and reliability (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); trusted assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); fear as expectation of injury (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); inducing another's fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`); visible manifestation of fear (`quranic:root_000447:B005/m01`); comprehension and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); direction toward truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Security is both an inner quiet and a reliable relation, while fear is both anticipated injury and its outward sign. Hearing understood as compliance supplies the transition between them: trusted assent changes not only a proposition but the hearer's projected relation to future harm.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bilginin ya da sözün başka birine gizlilik içinde ulaştırılmasını dalın çekirdeği olarak verir; gizli konuşma, dolaylı anlatım ve işaret bu aktarımın yollarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel aktarım çekirdeğini korur; gizli konuşma ve güvenilir elçi gönderme gibi kullanımları ayrı yapılara bağlı gerçekleşmeler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir bilgiyi ya da sözü, başkalarından gizli kalacak biçimde başka birine ulaştırmaktır. Bu ulaştırma gizli konuşma, dolaylı anlatım, işaret veya güvenilir bir aracı yoluyla gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bilgi veya söz bir başkasına gizlilik koşulu altında ulaştırılır.
Gizli konuşma, dolaylı anlatım ve işaret aktarımın farklı yollarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir bilginin veya sözün açıkça yayılmadan belirli bir alıcıya iletilmesidir; kullanılan araç çekirdeği değiştirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız Tanrı'nın seçilmiş kullarına bildirimde bulunmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bilgi olağan açık anlatımın dışında bir alıcıya ulaştırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aktarım biçimi ve gizlilikle tanımlanırken komşu dal gönderenin Tanrı olması ve alıcının seçilmiş kul olmasıyla sınırlandırılmıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça işaret etme, baş veya beden hareketiyle anlatma ve simge kullanma çevresinde kurar; bunların tümü doğrudan söylemeden anlam göstermenin yollarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her gizli bildirimi değil, anlamın işaret, hareket veya simgeyle gösterilmesini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel işaret çekirdeği korunur; bir kişiye işaret etme ve haberi işaretle ya da alçak sesle aktarma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlamı açıkça söylemek yerine işaret, beden hareketi veya simgeyle göstermektir. Belirli bir haberi hafif bir sesle duyurma kullanımı da bu dala eşlik eder.

facets.statement: Anlam, doğrudan söz yerine işaret, beden hareketi veya simgeyle gösterilir.
Belirli bir haber işaretle anlatılabilir veya hafif sesle duyurulabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar işaret, beden hareketi ve simgeyi aynı sözsüz ya da dolaylı gösterme alanında birleştirir; hafif sesle haber verme buna bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İşaret, beden hareketi ve simge yoluyla doğrudan olmayan anlatımın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Sözsüz veya dolaylı gösterme eylemini ve kullanılan araçları korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket yoluyla yöneltilmiş anlam göstermeyi korur.
